description: Simple and rapid application development framework, built on top of Flask. includes detailed security, auto CRUD generation for your models, google charts and much more. Demo (login with guest/welcome) - http://flaskappbuilder.pythonanywhere.com/

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: SAML role and group sync assignment at login by @dpgaspar in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2492
* fix: normalize and confine file manager upload paths by @dpgaspar in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2495
* fix: Validate the /back redirect target against FAB_SAFE_REDIRECT_HOSTS by @arpitjain099 in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2475
* release: 5.3.1 by @dpgaspar in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2498

## New Contributors
* @arpitjain099 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2475

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/compare/v5.3.0...v5.3.1
